name: CutScene
rows:
Maiden: Patience and focus are power. That is what fishing is.
Guillotine: M-Maiden, stop the nonsense! Hurry and pull me up!
Maiden: Ah! What a catch!
It's dark and scary in here! Save me!

Maiden: U-um... There are usually items in places like this in games, so I...
Vesti: I-I see.
Maiden: Can you get me out of here?

Guillotine: ...
Vesti: Hehe. It... It exploded...!
Guillotine: ...

Volume: Hey, can't you just jump to the side?
Guillotine: No way! A hero can only move forward!
Volume: What the...

Guillotine: It's this annoying feeling again! 
Maiden: Blasting off again!
Vesti: I-I'm flying...!

Volume: Hmm... Care to give me a hand?
Maiden: Hold on, let me write this down first. Trap ahead.
The most powerful White Ice Dragon lets out a roar.

Maiden: Attempting stop breathing. It's not. It's-it's not... It's not stopping! It's NOT!
Guillotine: WAAAAAAAAAGH!!!
Finally reached the end of the dungeon. The sun is shining.
I send praises to you, the one who came this far.
The excellence of Nikkes is the excellence of courage!
Our power is the best in the world!
Shall we go to the dungeon again?
In hardship and adversity, they grow stronger.
A cat walking upright might appear soon.
